context: Two teens debrief a tense club tryout result
purpose: Teach: 言うまでもない/とどまっ/ムダ/食わ/ピッタリ/成る/無言/失望

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 結果見た？私たち二人とも落ちてたよ…正直、失望しかない。
lines.en: Did you see the results? We both got cut. Honestly, nothing but disappointment.
lines.style: Deflated teenage girl, voice flat with hurt disbelief.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 言うまでもないけど、あれだけ練習したのにこの結果はキツいよな。
lines.en: Goes without saying, but after all that practice, this result really stings.
lines.style: Frustrated teenage boy, voice low and bitter.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 顧問の先生、最後まで無言で名簿見てたの怖かった…なんか心臓に悪いっていうか。
lines.en: The advisor stayed silent staring at the roster till the end, it freaked me out.
lines.style: Anxious teenage girl, voice tightening with remembered tension.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 正直、途中で帰ろうかと思ったけど、最後まで思いとどまって正解だったかも。
lines.en: Honestly, I almost left midway, but holding back and staying might've been the right call.
lines.style: Reflective teenage boy, voice quieter and a little uncertain.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ねえ、あんなに頑張ったのにムダだったのかな…私、ピッタリのポジションだと思ってたのに。
lines.en: Hey, was all that effort just wasted? I really thought that position fit me perfectly.
lines.style: Hurt teenage girl, voice cracking slightly with self-doubt.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ムダじゃないって。なんか一杯食わされた気分なのはわかるけど、来年もう一回挑めばいい。
lines.en: It wasn't wasted. I get the feeling of being duped, but we can challenge it again next year.
lines.style: Supportive teenage boy, voice firmer, trying to lift her up.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 来年か…そう簡単に気持ちが切り替わるもんじゃないよ。前向きに成るまで時間かかる。
lines.en: Next year, huh… feelings don't switch over that easily. Takes time to become positive again.
lines.style: Pensive teenage girl, voice soft and slow, gazing far away.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: だよな。でも今日くらいは落ち込んでいいって。明日からまた走り込みでもしようぜ。
lines.en: Yeah, true. For today, let yourself feel down. Tomorrow we'll start running drills again.
lines.style: Gentle teenage boy, voice warm with quiet determination.
